It's not just the energy, though; my mind is constantly replaying things. I keep thinking, 'Why did I say that to my ex-husband? What if I messed up that last deal? I'm such a failure.' These thoughts just spin and spin, always about how I’m not good enough or how things are hopeless. It’s hard to shake them off, but I don’t feel like I *have* to do anything to make them stop, if that makes sense. It’s just this constant loop of negativity about myself and my situation. I’ve even lost interest in things I used to love, like gardening. Food just tastes like ash, and I’ve probably lost about ten pounds without even trying. The worst are these thoughts that pop into my head, these really disturbing aggressive thoughts, like, what if I just snapped and hurt one of my clients? Or blasphemous thoughts that make me recoil. I don’t want to act on them, they just appear and make me feel even more disgusted with myself, like I’m a terrible person for even thinking them. I’m just so exhausted by it all."
